dedupe_keys.name: varden i siffror sweden health care quality and efficiency indicators by region hospital and municipality incl waiting times and acute care with data export

description: Vården i siffror is the Swedish regions' joint service for publishing data on the quality and efficiency of health care, run and developed by the Swedish Association of Local Authorities and Regions (SKR). The front page read on 2026-09-28 describes indicators that can be viewed by data source, including national quality registers, regional data collection and government agencies; by health care region, region and hospital; by municipality; and by theme or condition, such as waiting times, along with a view for the 26 national programme areas that steer clinical knowledge. A data export section and a new chart tool, launched on the day of reading, allow comparisons over time, between regions and between women and men, and follow-up reports cover areas such as acute care. Coverage is Sweden, down to hospital or municipality for many indicators. Access is free; no licence is stated on the front page, and the export format was not read. Caveats: indicators come from many sources with their own definitions and lags. It supports health service capacity studies, such as comparing emergency department waiting times across hospitals when planning surge capacity. No related Swedish health care record is catalogued.
